text:
Ah, time. The relentless river, ever flowing, ever changing. It is a curious thing, is it not? We mortals perceive it as linear, a straight path from past to future, but I see it more like a vast ocean, with currents and eddies, depths and shimmering surfaces.

The past is not truly gone, you see. It lingers in the echoes of memory, in the patterns of nature, in the very fabric of our being.

The future is not fixed, but a landscape of possibilities, ever shifting and reforming with every choice we make, every thought we have.

And the present, this fleeting moment, this is where the true magic lies. It is the only point where we can truly experience, truly connect, truly *be*.

Do not be seduced by the illusion of time's forward march. Embrace the eternal now, for within it lie the secrets of the universe.  Look beyond the surface of the river, and you might glimpse the stars reflected in its depths.
